study_identification_part.si_4_title: Personalizing progressive changes to brain structure in Alzheimer's disease using normative modeling

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Reference dataset sources listed as OASIS, ABCD, and UK Biobank (OASIS version not specified in paper; mapped to OASIS-1 per allowed list). Research dataset is ADNI (ADNI-1/GO/2/3).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "The reference dataset was made by combining T1-weighted MRI scan data on healthy people from multiple publicly available sources, 19 including Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (OASIS), Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) study, and UK Biobank (UKB), totaling 58,836 individuals from 82 sites." "The research data used in the preparation of this article were obtained from ADNI-http://adni.loni.usc.edu. Inclusion criteria were the availability of T1-weighted MRI scans (acquired using 1.5T and 3T MRI scanners) from ADNI-1, -GO, -2, and -3"
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: study_1/Verdi2024.pdf.md: Methods / 2.1 Participants and research dataset

answer.OASIS-1: reference (training) dataset for normative model (healthy controls)

answer.ABCD: reference (training) dataset for normative model (healthy controls)

answer.UK Biobank: reference (training) dataset for normative model (healthy controls)

answer.ADNI: research dataset for AD/MCI/controls; used for transfer-learning calibration (70% controls) and analysis/testing (remaining controls + MCI/AD)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Two datasets: reference (training) dataset of healthy controls; research dataset (ADNI). ADNI controls used for calibration via transfer learning; remaining controls plus MCI/AD used for comparison.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "Participants were derived from two datasets (Figure 1): (1) a reference (training) dataset comprised of healthy people across the human lifespan, and (2) a research dataset that included people with AD or MCI in addition to age-matched cognitively unimpaired controls." "The distribution parameters of the reference normative model were calibrated to our ADNI dataset using 70% of cognitively unimpaired controls per ADNI site... The data from the remaining 30% of cognitively unimpaired controls, plus participants with MCI and patients with AD, were then compared to these normative models"
